claims.assertion: Yazhi says an Egyptian Atlantean faction built the Sphinx over 12,000 years ago, before Giza’s pyramids, as a power symbol linked to Nile agriculture.
claims.speaker: Yazhi

claims.assertion: Yazhi interprets Adam and Eve as races: Adamic humans enslaved by Reptiles, and earlier Evas identified with Lemuria. Taygetan star-sisters shared knowledge that helped them resist control.
claims.speaker: Yazhi

claims.assertion: Yazhi describes Eden as an Atlantean human experiment in underground cities, around 15,000–12,500 years ago; she attributes ventilation to advanced construction and pressure-driven airflow.
claims.speaker: Yazhi

coverage_gaps: Sphinx symbolism and pair traditions; other religious and biological interpretations; further Eden allegory details.
